snippet.title: Smashing Bottles Relase Trailer
snippet.description:
Smashing Bottles is a short and satisfying incremental game where you break bottles to earn money, upgrade your bat, discover new bottles, and cause chaos! Will you smash enough bottles to buy the universe?

Check it out on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4637870/Smashing_Bottles/
